text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At Hatsune's request, {0} has gone shopping with her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はハツネに呼ばれて、
買い物に来ていた。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I shopped my little heart out! Thank you so much for
tagging along with me, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっぱい買っちゃった～
{0}くん、手伝ってくれてありがとね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot! They gave me something when
I got my change—
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、そうそう！
お会計の時に、なにかもらって──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wh-what's with this light?! It's so bright!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ！　
な、なに、
この光！？
まぶしい……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Nngh... I'm so sleepy all of a sudden... And I haven't even...
used my superpowers... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
なんだか急に眠く……
まだ超能力も……
使ってない、のに……
スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}! You decide what you're gonna buy?
I'm still on the fence...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、買うもの決めた？
私はまだ悩んでるんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hey, I like this one! I'm gonna get it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
いいの見つけた！
これにしよーっと！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wha... whaaa?! Wh-what's wrong, {0}?!
Why are you grabbing my hand like that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
えぇ！？
{0}くん、ど、ど、どうしたの！？
私の手、つかんだりして……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ooh, you were just reaching for the same thing?
R-right! You like this one too, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
お、
同じ商品を取ろうとしただけ……？
そ、
そっか、
{0}くんもこれが気に入ったんだね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Well, we're in trouble here. There's only one left.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、どうしよう？
これ最後の一個みたいだよぉ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
All right! This calls for a bout of rock-paper-scissors!
The winner gets to buy it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーしっ！
こうなったらジャンケンで勝負だよ！
勝ったほうのものだからね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Okay, here we go! Rock... paper... scissors!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
いくよー
じゃーん、
けーん……
チョキー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Aagh! I-I lost?!
I really wanted it, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ！　
ま、
負けちゃった……！？
ほしかったのにー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: But I guess that's life. I'm the one who suggested rock-paper-scissors, so the prize is yours, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
仕方ないよね。
ジャンケンって言い出したのは私だし……
{0}くんが買っていいよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? You thought I was gonna use my superpowers?
Just to win a game?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
なに？
私が超能力を使うと思ったの？
……ジャンケンに勝つために？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
We-heh-hell, just wait 'til I let you in on this little secret.
Superpowers must never be used for selfish reasons!
Sha-shing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ、
なめてもらったら困るよ。
超能力は、
私欲のためには使わないのだー！
きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hello there! If you have your receipt,
you can enter our lottery!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃいませー！
お買い物をしたレシートで、
もれなく福引きができまーす！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, {0}, look! It's a lottery wheel!
We just got done shopping, so I think we get a try.
Let's go for it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、見て見て！　
福引きだって！
さっき買い物したから、
出来るはずだよ。
行ってみようよー！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, sir! Let's see...
For this amount, you can try twice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、いらっしゃいませ！
ええっと……
この金額だと二回挑戦できますね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
The grand prize is a vacation for two!
Gosh, I'd love to go on a vacation...
Go on, {0}! I believe in you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一等は旅行のペアチケットだって！
旅行か～、
楽しそうだね～
{0}くん、バシッと当てちゃってよ！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: And it's white. Here's some tissues as a consolation prize.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──白ですね。
残念賞のティッシュです。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Aww... No good, huh? But that's okay!
You still have one more spin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ……
外れちゃった……
でも、
もう一回あるよね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You sure you're cool with me doing it?
All righty, I'll do my best! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
私が回していいの？
よーし、
頑張っちゃうよー☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
If I get first prize, I can go on vacation with {0}!
How cool would that be? The coolest ever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一等だったら、
{0}くんと旅行かぁ～！
すごいな～！　
すごいな～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh! B-but I'm not gonna use my powers! Obviously!
I would never! Not in a million years.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
で、
でも超能力は使わないのだ！
うん！　
使わない、
使わない……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
No superpowers... no superpowers...
Okay, maybe some superpowers.
choice_data_list: Sounds like you want to use your secret weapon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
超能力は使わない……超能力は使わない……
ちょっとしか……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: W-who me?! Not me! *whistle*
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そそ、
そんなことないよ！？
ヒュー、
ヒュー……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: N-no! I can't!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
ううん！
やっぱりダメだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But... it's a vacation getaway... Hnngh, I really wanna go!
Hiyah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
旅行のペアチケット……
うぅ、
ほしいよ～
えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: And iiit's... white! Here's your tissues, ma'am.
text_block_list.orig_text:
色は……
白！
残念賞のティッシュになります。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hrrgh! *sob*
I guess... no trips for me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぐっ！
うぅ……外しちゃったぁ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Too bad about that lottery, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
福引き、
残念だったねー

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we would have won if I'd used my superpowers,
but... that's totally cheating, huh?
Oh well, let's get back to shop—
text_block_list.orig_text:
超能力使えば、
当てられたと思うけど……
やっぱりそういうズルはしちゃダメだよね？
それはそれとして、
お買い物の続きを──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! I can't believe it! I've been looking for this
tote bag for ages! Lookie, lookie! Isn't it the cutest?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
あった！
このトートバッグ、
探してたんだー
見て見て～！　
かわいいよねぇ♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You were looking for this bag too, {0}?
But... what do we do? There's only one left...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
{0}くんも、
これ探してたの？
でも、どうしよう？　
これも最後の一個みたい……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
We're doing this again, huh?! Fine by me!
Rock-paper-scissors 2.0!
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ないね！
よーし！　
またジャンケンで勝負だよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Rooock... paper... PAPER!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーん、
けーん……
パー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You used... scissors?!
W-well, you know what? Take this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ……
{0}くんはチョキ！？
こ、
こうなったら！
……えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh!
text_block_list.orig_text: グググ……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I got you to do rock instead!
Therefore, I win!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！
{0}くんの手、
グーに変わったよ！
ということは、
私の勝ちー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It doesn't count 'cause I used my superpowers?
D-darn... Busted, huh? Heehee...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
超能力使ったから、
反則？
ば、
バレちゃった？
えへへ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry! I just need it, okay?!
Please don't be mad!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめーん、
どーしても欲しかったんだ！
許してー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
See, my little sister Shiorin told me she wanted this bag,
so I wanted to get it as a present for her...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
妹のしおりんが、
欲しいって言ってたから、
プレゼントしてあげたくて……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
B-but you're right. I shouldn't cheat. So here!
The bag is yours, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも、
ズルはダメだよね。
うん、
わかった！
このバッグは{0}くんが──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're okay with me winning?
Yaaay! Thank you so much, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
私の勝ちでいいの！？
わーい！　
{0}くん、ありがとー！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: And that's that. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Think of what you just saw as a dream of sorts.
Chances are you'll forget everything the second you wake up,
so no need to brood over it too much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが今、見てたのは夢みたいなものよ。
目覚めたらすぐに忘れちゃうと思うし、
今はあんまり気にしなくてもいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I gotta say, I never thought Hatsune actually had her act
together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にしても、
ハツネって、
意外としっかりしてるのね～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the little goofball winds up falling asleep without any
regard for time and place. I figured she'd just be using her
superpowers willy-nilly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
場所を気にしないで寝ちゃったりとか、
けっこう抜けてるところもあるから、
超能力も使いまくりかと思ったけど……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
It's not easy to resist the temptation to use those kinds of
powers for yourself. Most people wouldn't be able to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分のためには使わないって、
なかなか簡単にできることじゃないわよ。
普通なら誘惑に負けちゃうもの。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
But it looks like she's pretty firmly set on using them for
everyone but herself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
あの子はかたくなに
人のためにしか使わないのよね……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You know, that kinda reminds me of you, too. You always put
the well-being of others before your own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういう所は、
あんたと似てるのかもね。
自分より他人を優先しちゃうっていうか。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You'd better look after her to make sure she doesn't push
herself too hard. Hang in there, buddy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネが無理しすぎないように、
あんたが支えてあげなさいよね。
しっかりね～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*yawn* Boy, that felt good. I guess I fell asleep in the middle
of the road again? That's weird. I haven't used my superpowers
all day today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぁ～、
よく寝たー
また道で寝ちゃったんだ……
でも、
今日は超能力使ってないんだけどなー？？？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, were you sleeping too, {0}?
Wow, I wonder what happened to us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
{0}くんも寝てたの？
へぇー、
なんでだろ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I did have a really nice dream while I was out
though, so maybe it was for the best!
I was out shopping with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
でもおもしろい夢が見られたから、
よかったかな。
{0}くんと、
お買い物してたんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We did a lottery and—
Wait, how did you know that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう、
福引きを……って、
なんで知ってるの！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
We had the same dream? Whoa.
Talk about a crazy coincidence.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……同じ夢を見てたんだー
不思議なことってあるんだね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Though I kinda wish we'd had a better dream to share together!
Like, we could've at least won the lottery or something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
どうせ同じ夢なら、
もっといい夢がよかったよね～！
福引きがちゃんと当たったり、
とか……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! I almost forgot! We got lottery tickets when we
finished shopping in real life too! We might've just had
duds in our dream, but not here and now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
そういえば、
さっきお買い物した時、
福引き券もらったんだ！
夢では外れちゃったから、
今度こそいいもの当てようよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
U-um, but obviously, I'm not gonna use my powers!
At least, not much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もちろん超能力は使わないよ！
ちょっとしか……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Even though Hatsune swears she won't use her superpowers for
herself, she always has a hard time resisting the temptation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分のためには使わないと決めていても、
毎回誘惑に負けそうになるハツネであった。
